data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, a reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2018. In 2017 there was a reserve release of GBP 0.8m. The Liability, Marine and Accident and Health classes showed a reserve deterioration which was partially offset by a surplus in the Property and Credit and Political Risk accounts.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows a gross prior-year reserve strengthening of approximately GBP 37.3m (11.6% of opening gross claims outstanding) for years prior to and including 2016, derived from the gross claims development table. Management narrative reports a net reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m (net of reinsurance). The gross strengthening was driven by deterioration in Liability (Casualty), Marine and Accident & Health lines and adverse development in Professional Liability, partially offset by surplus/releases in Property and Credit & Political Risk. 2018 natural catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Michael and Florence, Typhoons Jebi, Mangkhut and Trami, California wildfires and Australian drought) also materially affected the Property portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall on an aggregate basis, a reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2018.
In 2017 there was a reserve release of GBP 0.8m.
The Liability, Marine and Accident and Health classes showed a reserve deterioration which was partially offset by a surplus in the Property and Credit and Political Risk accounts.

Our Professional Liability account also produced a significant loss, with additional information leading to increases in a number of large claims together with further attritional deterioration resulting in a significant strengthening of our prior year reserves.
Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 36). Management narrative reports a net prior-year strengthening of GBP 6.7m (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross figure derived from the triangle; the triangle extraction required reading the last non-empty development period for each underwriting year and computing prior-diagonal changes (excluded 2017 and 2018). Some rounding uncertainty applies. Where the report quoted only net movements in prose, the gross triangle was used per the extraction rules.
